Builddrone 0.6.2 stores documentation version history on `docs-versions`.
A push to `gh-pages` no longer starts GitHub's built-in pages build beside
the GitHub Actions deploy.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Publishing

### Version history leaves `gh-pages`

The Docs workflow deploys the published site with GitHub Actions. `mike`
previously wrote version history to `gh-pages`. A push to that branch starts
GitHub's built-in "pages build and deployment" workflow in addition to the
Actions deploy.

`mike deploy` and `mike set-default` now target `docs-versions`. The workflow
pushes that branch, then exports it as the Pages artifact. If
`docs-versions` does not exist yet, the first deploy copies the current
`gh-pages` history onto it.

In the repository Pages settings, keep the source set to **GitHub Actions**.
